name: Kiss Bridge
summary: West-facing bridge at Sunset Town: walk out to the 30 cm gap for the south-island sunset. Cầu Hôn stands on the beach at Thị trấn Hoàng Hôn, about 31 km from Dương Đông, with the middle left open by 30 cm. The cable ticket does not include the bridge or the Kiss of the Sea show. Give it the end of a south day.
getThere: About 31 km from Dương Đông, at Sunset Town
heroCaption: Kiss Bridge at sunset, the two spans stopping short over the water

notice.title: The cable ticket skips the bridge
notice.body: From 1 January 2026 the Hòn Thơm return ticket includes the cable car, the park, Làng Exotica, and Aquatopia. Cầu Hôn and the Kiss of the Sea show are paid extras.

body: Walk the bridge out over the west-facing beach and stop at the gap. Cầu Hôn is a landmark at Sunset Town, on the beach that faces due west at Thị trấn Hoàng Hôn. The middle is left open by 30 cm. Kiss of the Sea uses water, fire, laser, light, music, projection, fireworks, and a stage. From 1 January 2026 the bridge and the show are paid services outside the cable ticket.

Ga Ánh Dương, where the cable car starts, is the station at this town, about 31 km from thị trấn Dương Đông and about 21 km from the airport. The west-coast sunset is on Bãi Trường. This bridge is the south-island sunset, at the end of the cable-car day.

figures.caption: Kiss Bridge in daylight, from the sand and the palms at Sunset Town
figures.alt: Kiss Bridge stretching over the water beside a palm beach at Sunset Town

gettingThere: Cầu Hôn is at Thị trấn Hoàng Hôn, on the beach by ga Ánh Dương. The station is about 31 km from thị trấn Dương Đông and about 21 km from the airport, at Bãi Đất Đỏ. Ride south with the cable-car day and stay for the light.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: About 31 km south to Sunset Town. The bridge is on the beach at the cable-car station.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: About 21 km to ga Ánh Dương. The bridge is the walk on the sand once you are at the station.

admissionNote: From 1 January 2026, Cầu Hôn and Kiss of the Sea are paid extras on top of the cable ticket. The gap in the bridge is 30 cm. The show uses water, fire, laser, light, music, projection, fireworks, and a stage.
